note: RUBRIC_SLIM_SPEC batch: old U7 L3-6 (t-intervals and t-tests for a mean, matched pairs, two-sample t-interval; NEW Unit 4). These reflection questions enumerate the lesson's examples and numbers; CB scores the statistical idea once, not once per example. Interval = procedure + conditions (1), mechanics (1), interpretation in context (1), claim conclusion from the interval (1). Test = hypotheses with the parameter (1), procedure + conditions (1), mechanics (1), conclusion comparing p to alpha in context (1). Applied with scripts/rubric-slim-apply.mjs. Revised after the Codex review of new U3/U4 (DO NOT SHIP -> fixed): a full inference procedure requires the ids that compose College Board's four compound points (hypotheses incl. parameter, procedure + every condition, mechanics with work, decision + justification in context) even when that is 6-8 ids; explicitly requested interpretations and reasons restored; E/P/I made uniform and disjoint (all / all-but-one / two-or-more).
